about.title: About PR NEWS
about.intro: PR NEWS is a Canadian press release distribution platform designed for the modern era. We believe that every Canadian business deserves access to transparent, affordable, and effective press release distribution — regardless of size or budget.
about.mission: Make press release distribution transparent, fast, and accessible to every Canadian business.
about.closing: Our mission is simple: make press release distribution transparent, fast, and accessible to every Canadian business. From startups in Vancouver to non-profits in Halifax, we help stories find their audience.

sections.title: How to Write a Press Release
sections.content: A press release is a written communication that reports some relatively newsworthy event. The purpose of a press release is to provide information to journalists and the public.

sections.title: Best Practices
content: Keep your headline clear and compelling
Lead with the most newsworthy information
Add a quote from a company executive
End with a boilerplate about your company

sections.title: Distributing a Press Release in Canada
sections.content: When distributing a press release in Canada, consider reaching out to national and regional outlets across multiple provinces for maximum reach.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: PR NEWS is committed to protecting your personal information in compliance with Quebec Law 25 and PIPEDA.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email, and company details when you create an account.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our services, and to communicate with you about our products.

sections.title: 3. Data Sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers who assist us in operating our platform.

sections.title: 4. Your Rights
sections.content: Under Quebec Law 25 and PIPEDA, you have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal information.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
sections.content: We use cookies to enhance your experience. You can manage your cookie preferences at any time.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.content: For privacy inquiries, contact us at privacy@prnews.ca.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of the PR NEWS platform and services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

sections.title: 2. Use of Services
sections.content: You may use our services only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms.

sections.title: 3. Content
sections.content: You retain ownership of the content you submit. By submitting content, you grant us a license to distribute it through our network.

sections.title: 4. Prohibited Content
sections.content: Content must not be defamatory, illegal, or violate the rights of others. We reserve the right to reject any content.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: PR NEWS shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.

sections.title: 6. Governing Law
sections.content: These terms are governed by the laws of Ontario, Canada, applicable in Toronto without regard to conflict of law principles.

casl.title: CASL Compliance
casl.intro: PR NEWS complies with Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL). Our email practices include:
practices: Explicit consent: We only send emails to people who have explicitly opted in.
Identification: All emails clearly identify PR NEWS as the sender.
Unsubscribe: Every marketing email includes a one-click unsubscribe link.
Physical address: Our mailing address appears in the footer of every email.
casl.contact: For CASL-related inquiries, contact us at casl@prnews.ca.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: PR NEWS is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying the relevant accessibility standards.

sections.title: Conformance Status
sections.content: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) defines requirements for designers and developers to improve accessibility for people with disabilities. It defines three levels of conformance: Level A, Level AA, and Level AAA. PR NEWS is partially conformant with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Partially conformant means that some parts of the content do not fully conform to the accessibility standard.

sections.title: Feedback
sections.content: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of PR NEWS. Please let us know if you encounter accessibility barriers:
